### Clases definidas:

#### Clase `Process` (Línea 10)
- **Docstring:** _An asynchronous version of :class:`subprocess.Popen`._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def wait(self)` (Línea 14): Wait until the process exits.

:return: the exit code of the process
  - `def terminate(self)` (Línea 22): Terminates the process, gracefully if possible.

On Windows, this calls ``TerminateProcess()``.
On POSIX systems, this sends ``SIGTERM`` to the process.

.. seealso:: :meth:`subprocess.Popen.terminate`
  - `def kill(self)` (Línea 33): Kills the process.

On Windows, this calls ``TerminateProcess()``.
On POSIX systems, this sends ``SIGKILL`` to the process.

.. seealso:: :meth:`subprocess.Popen.kill`
  - `def send_signal(self, signal)` (Línea 44): Send a signal to the subprocess.

.. seealso:: :meth:`subprocess.Popen.send_signal`

:param signal: the signal number (e.g. :data:`signal.SIGHUP`)
  - `def pid(self)` (Línea 55): The process ID of the process.
  - `def returncode(self)` (Línea 60): The return code of the process. If the process has not yet terminated, this will
be ``None``.
  - `def stdin(self)` (Línea 68): The stream for the standard input of the process.
  - `def stdout(self)` (Línea 73): The stream for the standard output of the process.
  - `def stderr(self)` (Línea 78): The stream for the standard error output of the process.
